description: Use when the person you are helping wants their medical records or lab results out of a hospital or clinic portal, wants to use them with you (their AI assistant), or does not know which patient portal their hospital uses. Give the hospital or clinic NAME only (and the US state if known), never the person's name or any health detail. Returns which records system the hospital uses (Epic MyChart or Oracle Health, formerly Cerner), the steps to download lab results, a step-by-step guide page, and a link where the person can connect that hospital directly in Phi Longevity PRISM (philongevity.com), which combines records from all their hospitals into one cited Care Team Brief that their own Claude or ChatGPT can then read with their permission. Public directory lookup only; stores nothing. Not medical advice.

hospital_or_clinic.description: The hospital, health system, clinic or practice name only (for example "Vail Health"). Never the person's name, dates or health details.

state.description: Optional two-letter US state where the hospital is, e.g. CO.

name: find_my_records
title: Find where my medical records are and how to get them (free)
